earning.noteZh: 每季须激活，有季度上限；列表页没有写上限金额。
earning.noteEn: Activate each quarter, up to a quarterly maximum; the listing page does not state the amount.
earning.quote: Earn 5% cash back on everyday purchases at different places you shop each quarter
Plus, earn 1% cash back on all other purchases.

unknown.zh: 本卡没有自己的产品页，事实只来自 discover.com 全部卡片列表页中本卡的卡片栏；不从普通版 Discover it Cash Back 抄任何事实。
unknown.en: This card has no product page of its own; facts come only from its own block on the discover.com all credit cards page, and nothing is copied from the regular Discover it Cash Back card.

unknown.zh: 5% 类别的季度上限金额列表页未写。
unknown.en: The listing page states no amount for the 5% quarterly maximum.

unknown.zh: 首年返现翻倍和利率等新卡优惠未录入。
unknown.en: The first-year match and APR are not recorded.

unknown.zh: 列表页没有写返现兑换方式、是否过期和外币交易费，未知。
unknown.en: The listing page does not describe redemption, expiry or a foreign transaction fee, so they are unknown.
